question: Who among the following personalities was awarded the Padma Shri in 2021 for contributions to Folk dance ?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Manjamma Jogathi__**,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Transgender folk dancer **Manjamma Jogati** received a Padma Shri honour for her contribution to the arts today. 
 
• President Ram Nath Kovind handed over the award at the 2021 Padma awards ceremony at Rashtrapati Bhavan. 
 
• Jogati is also the first transwoman President of Karnataka Janapada Academy.
 
• **Kanaka Raju**, Padma Shri awardee who has kept tribal folk dance Gussadi alive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** The award is given in three categories, namely**:

 
 
• Padma Vibhushan for exceptional and distinguished service.
 
• Padma Bhushan for distinguished service of a high order.
 
• Padma Shri for **distinguished service**.
 
 
 
• Padma Shree, is the fourth-highest civilian award of the Republic of India, after the **Bharat Ratna, the Padma Vibhushan and Padma Bhushan.**
 
• Instituted on 2 January 1954, the award is conferred in recognition of "distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, acting, medicine, social service and public affairs".
